correctness.rationale: For each monomial C_{z^d}, the weighted basis maps e_n to r_d(n)e_dn with exact r_d=exp[−c/2{log(dn+1)^γ−log(n+1)^γ}]. For γ≤1 weakly null e_n have image norm bounded away from zero; γ>1 each term compact. In finite sum A+B, choose θ∈((log d0/log d1)^(1/(γ−1)),1); Ky Fan estimates make s_{n^θ}(B)=o(s_n(A)) and s_{n±n^θ}(A)/s_n(A)→1. Thus smallest degree controls all compact singular asymptotics despite output overlaps. At γ=2, r_d(n)∼d^(−c log d/2)n^(−c log d); p*=1/(c log d) yields residue |a_d0|^p* d0^(−1/2). Independently evaluated n s_n^p* for c=1.3,d=3 at n=10^6 as 0.577354917, approaching 1/sqrt3. Asymptotics rely on the argument, not this numeric point.
